name: Topple the Pillar of Heaven
text: Your ikon extends to an impossible length, striking all in its way. You deal max(6,floor(@actor.level / 2))d8 untyped damage to all creatures in a 60-foot line, with a basic Reflex save save against your class DC. The damage type matches that of your weapon. At 14th level and every two levels thereafter, the damage increases by 1d8.
